title: Extra Coal Ore Drop
description: Datapack, increasing coal drop from coal ore 🤯
body:
### ⛏️ Introduction

This datapack makes coal ore (including deepslate variant) drop 1-3 coal when mined.

### 🔧 Want to change the numbers?

In this case go to: `Extra Coal Ore Drop/data/minecraft/loot_tables/blocks/` 

Open the `.json` files and look for:

### `"min": 1.0`
### `"max": 3.0`

Change it to desired and save.
